clips.title: The story
paras: Lake Falathim is a tranquil body of water nestled in the forested hills of western Ashenvale, southwest of Maestra's Post. Revered for the constant touch of Elune's moonlight upon its surface day and night, it was once a beloved retreat for night elves. In recent days, however, aggressive murlocs have overrun its shores, turning a sacred haven into a perilous hazard.

Tucked away southeast of the Zoram Strand, Lake Falathim was long cherished by the Kaldorei as a peaceful sanctuary for swimming and fishing. According to local lore, the gentle radiance of Elune rests upon these waters at all hours, day or night. Despite this sacred blessing, ferocious murlocs have surged inland to seize the shores, nesting in thick numbers and driving away local travelers and scholars alike.

The sudden occupation by murlocs has made the lake deadly to solitary wanderers. The night elf scholar Teronis was recently lost somewhere near the water's edge on a mission of inquiry. Given the savage hostility of the amphibians lurking on the banks and in the shallows, the Sentinels fear the worst for any who venture toward the moonlit pool alone.
